component.summary: AI usage monitor for Claude.ai and OpenCode Go

description.p: A desktop usage monitor for Claude.ai and OpenCode Go. It polls both providers independently and displays rate-limit and usage data side-by-side in a single desktop dashboard.

ul.li: Session tokens are entered once in the browser (key screen), never the CLI.
